# Microsoft Fluent UI System Icons

- Upstream: https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons
- Pinned commit: `4d685f77b2cb8f3f412a74ec8d920c8c91149528`
- License: MIT (`LICENSE` in this directory)

The Outlook skin embeds only SVG path data from the following official files at
the pinned commit. No upstream URL is requested at runtime.

## Outlook favicon attribution

The local color favicon is a bundled copy of Microsoft's official Outlook
product SVG asset:
`https://res-1.cdn.office.net/files/fabric-cdn-prod_20230815.002/assets/brand-icons/product/svg/outlook_48x1.svg`
It is packaged as data in the extension; the extension does not request this
URL at runtime.
